mapper.select: SELECT conv.conversation_id, latest.plugin_name, latest.plugin_description, latest.status, latest.create_time AS update_time FROM ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(round) AS max_round FROM ai_chat_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_id ) conv INNER JOIN ai_chat_message latest ON latest.conversation_id = conv.conversation_id AND latest.round = conv.max_round AND latest.id = ( SELECT m.id FROM ai_chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = conv.conversation_id AND m.round = conv.max_round ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY latest.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{count}
